login.title: Welcome back
login.subtitle: Sign in to see your trips and book in one go.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: One account for every ferry, flight and taxi.
register.sentBody: If this address can be used, we've sent you a message with the next step. It can take a minute to arrive.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.done: Your email is confirmed. Thank you.
verify.failed: This link has expired or was already used. Request a new one below.
verify.missing: This page needs the link from your email.
verify.resent: If that address needs confirming, a new link is on its way.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that address, a reset link is on its way. It works once and expires in an hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Your password was changed. Please sign in again.
reset.missing: This page needs the link from your email.

fields.passwordHint: At least 10 characters. A few random words make a strong one.

errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: That email and password don't match. Try again or reset your password.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_COMMON: That password is too easy to guess. Try a longer phrase.
errors.PASSWORD_CONTAINS_EMAIL: Don't use your email name inside your password.
errors.TOKEN_INVALID: This link has expired or was already used.
errors.NETWORK: We couldn't reach Dhathuru. Check your connection and try again.
errors.GENERIC: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.

manage.title: Your account
manage.unverified: Your email isn't confirmed yet. Confirm it to book trips.

travellers.title: Saved travellers
travellers.empty: No saved travellers yet. Add the people you travel with to book faster.
travellers.name: Full name
travellers.documentNote: We never store ID or passport numbers.

security.title: Security
security.passwordChanged: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.body: This permanently deletes your account, saved travellers and preferences. Anonymised booking records may be kept for accounting.
